text: This nature is unattainable by those whose spiritual practices are insufficient [thinking it is] subtle. This is the state of equilibrium of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas. This is the intellect, this is the ego, these are the five subtle elements, the eleven senses, the five great elements, and this is the distinct Purusha. The intellect makes known that [the Purusha] is separate from these; and for the one whose intellect [realizes this], liberation is attained.
